name: realistic
notes: Real firearms in the arena's roles: the rocket launcher's pad holds a shoulder rocket, the scrap gun's a shotgun, the minigun's a machine gun, the skipjack's an assault rifle, the arc gun's a flamethrower, the goo gun's a grenade launcher, the bore's an anti-materiel rifle that goes through walls. The melee spot holds a shovel or a knife, drawn once a match, so every pad of it agrees.
title: Realistic
